summary: M28 Phase 2 Architecture Decoupling — 将三个架构耦合点分解为 4 个可执行 task：Wave 1 修复 Container/MCP 启动路径 + GatewayDeps ISP 拆分；Wave 2 提取 craft-types 并转换 craft-catalog 为 lazy getter。
approach: 增量式重构：先修复跨层 import 路径和接口契约，再处理循环依赖。每个 wave 保证测试编译通过。GatewayDeps 作为 backward-compatible alias 保留。

stages: split GatewayDeps monolith into role interfaces
extract craft-types.ts to break type cycle
convert eager const exports to lazy getters

design_decisions: Keep GatewayDeps as a backward-compatible alias (type intersection) so existing consumers compile without change
No new DI framework — use existing interface + composition-root patterns
craft-catalog.ts barrel export remains stable; internal const->getter changes are breaking for direct consumers but all affected consumers are updated in TASK-004
mcp/engine.ts getContainer() usage is out of scope for TASK-001; requires separate parameter-injection or factory approach
